note: Every generated file that no game/src reader reaches must be named here with a reason. Kinds: text_via_locres, folded_into_aggregate, producer_intermediate, build_manifest, provenance, tests_only, placeholder, blocked_on_team (needs owner). A rule that names a consumer must also name the claim_token that proves the claim (a literal the consumer file contains); the checker fails when it is absent. A rule that matches nothing fails the gate unless marked optional:true — optional exists only for a producer whose output this environment has not regenerated yet (T01-PIPELINE staged the curve/ini/input/collision producers against a read-only shared data tree); drop the flag after `make normalize` proves the file exists. See tools/check_consumers.py.

rules.reason: StringTable text reaches the runtime through the locres pipeline: parse_locres.py writes localization/*.csv + sources.json and Loc reads them. The normalised table is extraction provenance, not a second source of truth (RE-A-03).
Clue facts are folded into gameplay/clues.json by parse_clues.py and read from there by game_data.gd; the per-set tables duplicate the same fact ids (RE-A-12).
Wwise voice/priority tables are extracted but read by no producer and no runtime file (measured: `rg -l 'Audio_Data|DT_Audio_Voice' tools/*.py game/src` -> 0). T03-AUDIO owns the Wwise control plane.

Wwise surface/reverb routing tables are extracted but read by no producer and no runtime file (measured: `rg -l 'WwiseAudio|DefaultGeometrySurfaceProperties' tools/*.py game/src` -> 0). T03-AUDIO owns the Wwise control plane.
Loot info tables and the loot CDT are read by parse_loot.py to build gameplay/loot_actors.json; the runtime reads the aggregate.
Composite contract table is the authored source for gameplay/contracts.json (parse_contracts.py); the runtime reads the aggregate.
Authored Mission.Example.* fallback rows the map checker uses when a sublevel declares no mission record; not gameplay content.
Per-map quest graphs and fact tables are read by parse_quests.py and emitted as gameplay/quests.json; the runtime never opens the per-map copy.
DT_WeatherTypes is read by parse_hearing.py (sound-carry per weather) and by parse_weather.py; the runtime reads weather/*.json.
Thief-vision indicator table and the major-loot glyph curve have no HUD reader; T05-UI owns the indicator layer (RE-A-01, RE-A-03).
DT_InteractPromptStyles drives the authored interact-prompt widget styles; the prompt UI is hand-built, so T05-UI owes the consumer.
Match-settings gameplay-tag groups have no runtime reader; T10-GAMEPLAY owns match settings and the run clock.
DT_InputKeysToGlyphs is the authored key->glyph table; T06-INPUT owns input_glyphs.gd (RE-A-04).
HUD/compass/toast/rich-text tables and the mouse+gamepad sensitivity curves have no runtime reader; the UI and the sensitivity model are T05/T06 deliverables.
C_EyeGlow (colour curve for the eye material) has no material reader; T08-MATERIAL owns the material graph port.
Wwise decode manifest: the source->ogg mapping convert_wwise.py uses to rebuild assets/ue/audio/wwise. The runtime reads audio_events.json.
Per-slot material provenance emitted for audit; parse_materials.py writes and checks it, no runtime reads it.
Device census used by the audit content check (families/expected counts). The runtime reads gameplay/devices_runtime.json.
15 transcoded .ogv clips (153 MB) have no VideoStreamPlayer; T05-UI owns the screens that must play them (RE-A-06).
21 authored StateTrees (784 KB) have no runtime consumer; T11-AI owns the guard behaviour consumer (RE-A-02).
Movement constants are asserted by game/tests/test_m2_player.gd; the runtime carries its own tuned constants.
State-speed rows are asserted by game/tests/run_tests.gd; no game/src reader.
Applied override table is asserted by game/tests/test_content_overrides.gd; check_content_overrides.py re-derives it from the levels.
Niagara system catalogue is asserted by the E2E tiers; the runtime spawns the systems directly and never reads the catalogue (RE-A-03).
Curve index: which standalone curve assets were emitted into tables/** and which curve objects are Blueprint sub-object defaults. The runtime reads the per-asset tables, not this index.
DefaultGame.ini producer (XP, MaximumLevel, endgame durations, authored map->mission lists). T10-GAMEPLAY owns the consumer; the producer exists to unblock it.
Enhanced-Input ingest (91 shipping mappings / 52 actions). T06-INPUT owns the consumer and the rebinding model.
AggGeom simple-collision primitives per mesh. T09-GEOMETRY owns collision creation in the loader; T11 needs the hulls for nav.
